title: job.cancel
description: Requests cancellation of a job (PROTOCOL.md section 12.3). Cancellation is asynchronous: the job stops at its next cancellation point and then reaches state cancelled, or succeeded if it finished first. Poll job.get for the outcome. Cancelling a terminal job is a no-op success with cancelRequested false.

cancelRequested.description: true: cancellation was requested now or earlier and the job was not terminal. false: the job was already terminal; nothing was done.

job.description: The job as it is right after the request.
